records.name: UMeterGroup

records.name: UTerminal
records.surface: UTerminal is a function; UTerminalProps welcomeMessage, prompt="$", className. Enter submits nonempty input via terminalEventBus command, appends history and clears input; ArrowUp wraps history. Container clicks focus input; renders scroll to bottom. Responses update the latest existing command; clear event empties commands and history index. Listeners unregister on unmount. Responses have aria-live polite. terminalStyleModule is source-only; bus is separately inventoried. Styled using useComponentBase and local CSS; props do not expose dt, unstyled or pt.

records.name: useKeyFilter
records.purpose: Filters input keypress and paste events.
records.surface: useKeyFilter(inputRef, options) returns void. UseKeyFilterOptions accepts pattern?: RegExp | UKeyFilterPattern, validateOnly=false and when=true. UKeyFilterPattern presets are pint, int, pnum, money, num, hex, email, alpha and alphanum. Internal DEFAULT_MASKS and resolveRegex select the regex. Enabled effects attach keypress and paste listeners and remove them on cleanup; keypress validateOnly bypasses filtering, modifiers and Enter bypass too. Keypress tests current value plus key without caret awareness; paste tests individual characters even in validateOnly. Stateful custom regex lastIndex is not reset. No local style module or useComponentBase.

records.name: useStyleClass
records.purpose: Applies classes and transitions to a target on trigger interaction.
records.surface: useStyleClass(triggerRef, options) returns void. UseStyleClassOptions selector supports @next, @prev, @parent, @grandparent or a document selector, plus enterFromClass, enterActiveClass, enterToClass, leaveFromClass, leaveActiveClass, leaveToClass, toggleClass, hideOnOutsideClick, hideOnEscape, hideOnResize. Dismissal flags default false. Target is cached on first click. toggleClass toggles directly; otherwise offsetParent determines enter or leave. Active animations wait for animationend; immediate branches remove From and add To. Dismissal listeners apply to enter/leave. Cleanup removes trigger/document/window listeners and resets target, but not in-flight animationend listeners or animating flag. No local style module or useComponentBase.

records.name: Terminal event bus
records.purpose: Shares command, response and clear events with terminal instances.
records.surface: terminalEventBus is a public singleton created with EventBus(); UTerminalCommand has text: string and response?: string. EventBus provides on, off, emit and clear; bus.clear() removes listeners, whereas emit("clear") asks mounted terminals to clear their command logs. Responses apply to the latest command. The bus is shared across instances.
